title: PowerShell Engram control fixture refuses canonical test homes when Windows TEMP uses an alias
outcome: The PowerShell Engram control fixture accepts the existing test home when the allowed Windows user-temp path is spelled through an 8.3 short name or directory junction, while retaining exact component containment, raw parent-traversal and verbatim-prefix refusals. This is a source-inferred, environment-dependent Low inherited from43a55125; known Windows gate hosts are green. It is separate from the Mac shell guard repair and grants no new implementation authority under the current STOP.
acceptance: The existing fixture owner treats lexical and final Windows user-temp spellings as the same allowed root, with a regression using a repository-contained junction or available short-name alias and the canonical TestTempRoot home.
Outside-root, same-prefix sibling, parent-traversal and existing verbatim-prefix refusal controls retain their exit4/message and prove no outside writes.
The relevant focused Windows checks and standard review pair pass on the exact proposed input, with no production path-policy or timing-budget change.
